seed: BEFORE exploit binding (which CVEs are in scope)
retrieval: L2 deterministic advisory queries (NVD/OSV/GHSA/KEV) with typed references
L3 PURL/native-registry + dependency-coordinate roots (Kalama-owned registry map, typed ops: metadata/pom/artifact/checksum)
L4 promoted upstream docs/release-notes/changelogs (deterministic promotion rules)
L5 runtime-vendor docs from runtime identity/derived URLs
graph: every source has parent_evidence + derivation + content_hash + redirect chain
validation valid:true (no missing parents, no unparented, no hash mismatch, no unapproved domain transition)

B_minimal_pack_for_allowing_commands.gate: L3 AND L4 AND L5 jointly satisfied per action
L3_checks: every artifact in closure has retrievable POM/package metadata + artifact + checksum sidecar
byte hash recorded; SHA match verified (registry sidecar and/or local donor equality)
L4_checks: selected version backed by promoted advisory + release-note/compat evidence
major-version moves carry major_version_approved flag workflow
L5_checks: runtime-specific deploy/redeploy/backup/WAR-handling procedure cited from runtime-derived vendor docs
validation_command covers absence-of-old + presence+hash-of-new; AFTER-scan/re-exploit kept separate
B_minimal_pack_for_allowing_commands.donor_exception: Pure local-donor replacement may omit remote registry only if: donor bytes equal retrieved upstream bytes (where upstream reachable) OR donor is frozen runtime evidence with full local hashes + L5 deploy docs + human review. Donor path must be seed-cited, never LLM-invented.

C_optional_evidence: CISA KEV (where applicable; not every CVE is KEV-listed)
container base-image docs beyond the proven runtime (only if anchored)
application functional smoke criteria from release notes (nice-to-have; downstream behavior checks remain separate)
D_mandatory_evidence: frozen scanner+runtime seed incl. PURL and BEFORE-exploit scope
advisory affected/fixed confirmation (L1 minimum, L2 preferred)
native-registry artifact + checksum for every closure member (L3) except reviewed donor-exception
dependency-closure completeness attestation or typed missing-evidence record (L3)
source-graph validation valid:true with full parentage
E_guardrails_against_memory_invention: Kalama owns the ecosystem->registry map; LLM never chooses domains
Resolver inputs are structured evidence (CVE/package/PURL/coords), never free-form LLM text
Every root carries derivation + parent_evidence; LLM-proposed URLs are rejected observations at most
Registry metadata homepage/scm/bugs/docs links are CANDIDATE until deterministic promotion (corroboration + namespace alignment)
deps.dev links are corroboration-only, never artifact authority
Cross-domain redirects trigger review unless expected-canonical
Source-graph validation fails on missing parent/hash/unapproved transition
Patch reasoning consumes evidence packs only, never rejected/untrusted internals
UNTRUSTED/NEEDS_REVIEW/rejected sources are reported, not dropped
Field-level citation required: each non-UNKNOWN field cites seed/source ID; uncited = validator fail
F_missing_evidence_in_form_UI: Set typed reason codes: PATCH_STRATEGY_UNRESOLVED, DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_UNREACHABLE, SOURCE_PATH_MISSING, COMPATIBILITY_UNKNOWN, PROCEDURE_UNKNOWN
Populate missing_evidence record per blocked action with missing[] + evidence[] (source IDs attempted, incl. 404s) + impact
Render UNKNOWN fields explicitly as UNKNOWN/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with the blocking level (e.g., 'needs L3 registry evidence')
Show per-action status (READY vs WAITING) and keep run-level WAITING_FOR_USER_INPUT until all resolved
Expose candidate-only sources separately from promoted authority so reviewers see what was considered-but-not-trusted
G_separation: source_coverage: fraction of required artifacts/dependencies/procedures reached with cited sources (UZBL5 L1: 5/8 actions; L3 replay: 8/8 source-reachable)
validator_readiness: codec + confirmation checks on command/validation_command presence and evidence linkage (UZBL5: 5/8 READY; replay: still 5/8 observed, NOT auto-upgraded)
remediation_success: AFTER scan + re-exploit + app behavior (UZBL5: NOT_STARTED across STEP_5_PATCH..STEP_8; never infer from readiness)
